components.name: Lower hull, 7 clear SLA pieces
components.role: keeps water out below the belly seam
components.how: One keel cap and six gores, cut at z = -0.274 m. Inward flanges are screwed together over a silicone cord seal.
components.test: Join two gore pieces, sink the seam 300 mm for 48 h, check for drops.

components.name: Seam seal: silicone cord, A4 screws, epoxy
components.role: seals every flange joint of the clear shell
components.how: Removable seams: 2.5 mm silicone cord in a printed groove, M3 A4 screws at 30 mm. Permanent seams: DP100 Plus Clear.
specs: from Parker Section IV, not read yet
components.test: Bond two Clear V5 coupons with DP100 Plus, soak 7 days, pull by hand.

components.name: Rear wall, 2 clear halves
components.role: frames the rear bore above water; carries the lead in recess and the dock pads
components.how: The rear cap aft of x = -0.325 m, split left and right. The face holds a 37.5 deg recess around the bore and 3 flush steel pads. Halves bond with DP100 Plus and screw to the bore ring and gores.
specs: 3 pockets 40 x 40 x 4 mm at r 185, 90/210/330 deg
components.test: Check both halves fit the Form 4L in the slicer.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: carries the 30 mm lead in recess and the 3 steel pads; the bore now sits above water.

components.name: Bore ring D 250 with petal seat
components.role: clear bore for the arm; seat for the petal hinge and the dock seal
components.how: A ring at the bottom of the recess: 7 mm shoulder from D 264 to the D 250 bore. The tail collar lip seals on the shoulder; the petal hinge ring screws behind it.
specs: D 250 mm (arm passage pose needs R 113.7)
components.test: Pass the DexArm in the passage pose through the ring 20 times; smallest gap 7 mm or more.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: becomes the bore ring at the bottom of the lead in recess; pads move to the rear wall face.

components.name: Front plate with canal ring, 2 clear halves
components.role: holds the birth canal at 21 deg
components.how: A clear frame across the nose. The canal ring clamps the sleeve and the lips. Halves bond with DP100 Plus.
components.test: Clamp a sleeve offcut in the ring and pull 50 N.

components.name: Belly origami skin, SORTA-Clear 18
components.role: upper skin; pleats open as the womb fills
components.how: Cast clear silicone with 5 concentric elliptical pleats around the crown, clamped to the hull rim by a printed ring. 24 clear nylon cords in the skin along meridians go straight at 10 L and stop the rise.
specs: 5, pitch 45 mm, depth 14 mm at the sides, 9 mm at the ends
0.29 m2 above z 0.164, aft limit x -0.30
24 x 0.5 mm clear nylon, cut to the 10 L meridian
6.1 mm per L; 51 mm for 8.35 L; 61 mm at the 10 L stop
components.test: Pleat strip with 3 cords on a pressure box to 2 kPa; then the full belly at 2 to 10 L, measure crown rise.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: pleat sizes from the belly geometry; 24 nylon cords cast in as the 10 L stop.

components.name: Gel pool tray, round, 4 clear quarters
components.role: holds the support gel over the keel
components.how: A round tray with vertical walls down to the hull, centered under the print. The front quarter is notched where the chute enters. Quarters bond with DP100 Plus.
components.test: Fill with water 24 h before the first gel.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: round D 410 on the print center x -0.040; 18 L; front quarter notched for the chute.

components.name: Birth chute, one clear print
components.role: carries the floating baby from the gel up to the canal
components.how: A ribbed trough on the canal bottom line at 20.8 deg, from 30 mm under the gel surface to the canal low point. Fixed to the tray front quarter and the front plate.
specs: 2 mm ribs along the slope, 10 mm pitch
components.test: Pull a 1.7 kg silicone dummy up a chute strip at 20.8 deg, wet with gel and dry.
components.changed_in_v2: new in v2

components.name: Petal door, 6 cast silicone petals
components.role: closes the rear bore when no tail is docked
components.how: Six petals hinged on a ring at D 256 behind the bore shoulder. One drawstring on an N20 gear motor (mother node H bridge) pulls them open to 135 deg into the womb; the cast shape closes them. The dock seal holds the womb while docked, so the door never holds pressure.
specs: splash only; bore 20 mm above water
components.test: Open and close 200 times; open petals must stay outside D 250.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: actuated petals opening to 135 deg out of the bore; splash guard only, holds no pressure.

components.name: Birth canal soft sleeve, Ecoflex 00-30
components.role: soft passage the baby is pushed through
components.how: A thin cast tube tucked inside the canal ring. The baby, pushed and inflated, turns the sleeve out.
components.test: Pull a 250 mm ball through a sleeve sample; log the force.

components.name: Duckbill lips, SORTA-Clear 18
components.role: keeps womb air in; opens only to the baby
components.how: Four cast lips pressed shut by their own preload. The baby forces them apart; they close again after.
components.test: Seal the lips on a jar, raise to 1.2 kPa, check for bubbles.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: canal low point 80 to 98 mm above the v2 waterline.

components.name: Tail shell, gourd form, one PETG print
components.role: dry hull for arm, power, pump and thrusters
components.how: One large FDM print, outside sealed with epoxy. Same mouth as the mother rear face, then wider and lower behind the seam; bottom level with the mother keel. Heavy parts sit low in the belly.
specs: Elegoo OrangeStorm Giga, 800 x 800 x 1000 mm
D 466 at x_t -0.22, center 50 mm lower
components.test: Float the tail with all parts: axis 145 mm above water within 5 mm; heel 10 deg by hand; the tail must return upright.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: gourd form so the tail floats level at dock height (old form floated 2.4 kg there).

components.name: HIWIN MGN12H rails and carriage
components.role: carry the arm forward into the womb
components.how: Two parallel rails on a keel beam in the tail belly, two blocks each, under a 280 x 120 x 6 mm boom plate. The DexArm base sits 70 mm ahead of the front blocks.
specs: 370 mm; home base x_t -0.327; stations x_t -0.040, +0.040

sources.label: HIWIN MG series catalog (HIWIN document, hosted by distributor Motion)

components.test: Extend fully with the arm on; dial gauge sag at the arm base under 0.3 mm.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: 500 mm rails level, x_t -0.530 to -0.030; stroke 370 mm; two print stations.

components.name: Boom drive: NEMA 17 and GT2 belt
components.role: moves the carriage once, then holds
components.how: One stepper at the front end drives a closed GT2 belt to a rear idler. The boom moves to a station and holds while the arm prints; two stations per layer.
components.test: Move between stations 50 times; dial gauge repeat within 0.1 mm.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: stroke 370 mm; motor at the front end; steps between two print stations.

components.name: Rotrics DexArm, Starter Kit
components.role: prints and places inside the womb
components.how: A four axis desktop arm on the boom plate. Marlin G-code over USB from the Pi.
specs: upper arm 70, forearm 60 deg (film convention), head needle up: R 113.7 mm
components.test: Print a 100 mm square in gel 10 times; measure spread of corners.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: passage pose, print stations and reach band added.

components.name: Blue Robotics 14.8 V 18 Ah battery
components.role: powers arm, pump, thrusters and controller
components.how: One 4S6P Li-ion tube. A 14.8 to 12 V converter feeds the DexArm; a 5 V supply feeds the Pi.

sources.label: Blue Robotics 14.8 V 18 Ah battery BR-100842

components.name: Raspberry Pi 5 and BTT SKR Pico
components.role: runs the job; drives steppers, pump, valves
components.how: The Pi sends G-code to the DexArm and runs Klipper. The SKR Pico drives the boom and cartridge steppers.
specs: BCM2712, 4 x A76 2.4 GHz, 5 V 5 A USB-C
RP2040, TMC2209 in UART mode, 12/24 V

components.name: Blue Robotics T200 thrusters
components.role: move the tail to the baby and dock
components.how: Two thrusters low on the tail. Run at low throttle for a slow, quiet approach.
specs: 427 g in air, 239 g in water
components.changed_in_v2: v2: mounted on the gourd sides, about 75 mm under water.

components.name: Trim ballast, stainless, mother and tail
components.role: set both bodies level at the design waterline
components.how: Mother: 1.5 kg in the bilge at x -0.27. Tail: 1.8 kg low at x_t -0.29. Add or remove 191 g pieces to hold the hatch axis 145 mm above water.
specs: AISI 316, 191 g in air, 165 g in water
hatch axis 145 mm above water, level (computed)

sources.label: Blue Robotics stainless ballast 200 g BR-101039

components.test: Float the loaded tail beside the mother; match axis heights within 5 mm.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: foam dropped (inside a dry hull foam adds no lift); stainless ballast in both bodies.

components.name: Small brackets, PETG
components.role: mounts for servos, pump, cartridge, pogo block
components.how: Printed on the owned Flashforge Adventurer 5M, 0.6 mm nozzle, PETG.

components.name: Nordson EFD 600 ml 1:1 side by side cartridge
components.role: stores silicone A and B for one baby
components.how: Fixed in the tail belly under the rails with the mixer at its outlet. One plunger yoke pushes both sides at 1:1. A 1.0 m mixed line runs in the drag chain to the head.
specs: 666 ml with waste: baby silicone 0.61 L or less, else change at a cap layer

sources.label: Nordson EFD side by side 2K cartridges
medmix MIXPAC Systems for Adhesives brochure (medmix document, hosted by Ellsworth)

components.test: Fill by hand, push 10 ml, weigh A and B outputs for 1:1.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: one 600 ml cartridge per baby, fixed in the tail belly, not on the boom.

components.name: StepperOnline NEMA 23 lead screw plunger, 1.5875 mm lead
components.role: pushes the cartridge plungers slowly and evenly
components.how: An external lead screw stepper pushes a printed yoke on both pistons. Slow, steady flow sets the bead.
components.test: Push DS10 NV through the full line at 15, 20, 25 mm/s bead speed; log motor current.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: 1.5875 mm lead version, 750 N, for margin at 20 mm/s.

components.name: medmix MIXPAC MFQ 05-16L static mixer
components.role: mixes A and B on the way out
components.how: Disposable quadro mixer on the cartridge in the tail belly. A 1.0 m x 4 mm line in the drag chain carries mixed silicone to the head.

sources.label: medmix MIXPAC Systems for Adhesives brochure (medmix document, hosted by Ellsworth)

components.test: Run 15 min, stop 8 min, restart; mixer must not block.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: mixer at the fixed cartridge; 1.0 m x 4 mm line.

components.name: B. Braun three way stopcock
components.role: switches the needle from silicone to air
components.how: A Luer stopcock at the head, turned by a servo. Silicone and air never share a line upstream.
specs: single use; swap with each mixer

sources.label: B. Braun three way stopcock D300, REF 456003
Artist's Weekly Updates deck (S8 design, gel tests)

components.test: Turn the lever with the servo 200 times under 2 bar.

components.name: Feetech STS3215 servos (from owned SO-ARM101)
components.role: turns the stopcock lever; tilts the head
components.how: Two bus servos from the owned SO-ARM101: one turns the stopcock, one tilts the head so the needle points up while the arm passes the hatch.
specs: 16.5 kg cm at 6 V (7.4 V version)
components.changed_in_v2: v2: second servo tilts the head needle up for the hatch passage.

components.name: Stepped needle: 12G Luer body, 14G tip
components.role: prints the bead, carries the capsule, inflates the baby
components.how: A 12G blunt Luer needle (custom 95 mm) with a 14G stainless cannula bonded 10 mm into the tip and 20 mm exposed. Silicone first; then air through the same needle into the capsule valve.
specs: 12G, ID 2.16 / OD 2.77 mm, 95 mm, Luer lock

sources.label: PVA G series dispense needles (12G, custom to 4 in)
Nordson EFD general purpose tips (gauge chart)

components.test: Push 10 ml through at 20 mm/s equivalent; check the joint for leaks at 2 bar.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: stepped needle cuts the drop to 0.88 bar at 20 mm/s with the same 14G bead.

components.name: KNF NMP830 diaphragm pump
components.role: blows air; can also suck gel back
components.how: Brushless diaphragm pump in the tail. Inlet through a snorkel on the tail top (outside air); outlet to the stopcock air port. Air drawn from the womb would give no belly rise.
specs: 12 or 24 V DC, 1.10 A at 12 V
components.changed_in_v2: v2: inlet through a snorkel to outside air, so the belly rises one for one.

components.name: Clippard EV-2-12 vent valve
components.role: relief: vents womb air above the set point
components.how: Opened by the controller when the BMP390 reads over 1 kPa. A dip tube 100 mm under water is the passive backup.
components.test: Pump the joined air space; check vent opens at 1.0 kPa.

components.name: Bosch BMP390 pressure sensors
components.role: measure womb, ambient and baby air pressure
components.how: Gauge pressure = womb sensor minus ambient sensor. A third sensor sits in the baby capsule.

components.name: Support gel: Carbomer 940, 1% w/v
components.role: holds the liquid silicone while the silicone cures
components.how: 1 g Carbomer 940 per 100 ml DI water, neutralized with 1 M NaOH, rested sealed about one day.
specs: Carbomer 940 at 0.5% w/v, NaOH to pH 7
not measured; organogel at 3 to 4 Pa holds silicone (O'Bryan)

components.name: Neutralizer: 1 M NaOH
components.role: opens the Carbopol chains so the gel holds
components.how: Add by syringe after the powder is fully wetted and bubbles have risen.
specs: 0.832 ml 1 M NaOH per 100 ml of 1% gel

sources.label: Hinton et al. 2016, doi 10.1021/acsbiomaterials.6b00170 (Europe PMC full text)
Baby Robots Material Fabrication Updates (gel recipe)

components.changed_in_v2: v2: dose for 18 L.

components.name: Print silicone: Dragon Skin 10 NV
components.role: the baby's printed skin
components.how: Platinum silicone, 1:1. Printed into the gel through the mixer and the stepped needle at 20 mm/s.

sources.label: Smooth-On Dragon Skin 10 NV technical bulletin
Artist's Weekly Updates deck (S8 design, gel tests)
Hinton et al. 2016, doi 10.1021/acsbiomaterials.6b00170 (Europe PMC full text)
O'Bryan et al. 2017, doi 10.1126/sciadv.1602800 (NSF PAR full text)

components.test: Print two touching beads in gel; after cure peel them apart by hand.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: Dragon Skin 10 NV (6,000 cps) replaces FX-Pro (18,000 cps); same material as the fold model.

components.name: Cast silicone: SORTA-Clear 18
components.role: clear silicone for belly, lips, door and seal
components.how: Cast in printed molds. Mix by weight, degas, cure about 24 h. Trial kit in hand; about 4 kg more needed.

sources.label: Artist's Weekly Updates deck (S8 design, gel tests)

components.name: Patch silicone: Ecoflex 00-35 FAST
components.role: quick seals at the capsule and tube stubs
components.how: Brushed on by hand where a fast seal is needed. Too fast for the static mixer.

components.name: Zubax FluxGrip FG401MA electropermanent magnets
components.role: hold the tail on the hoop; release on command
components.how: Three units in the tail rim press on the iron pads of the bore hoop. A short pulse switches hold on or off.
specs: 250 N each on 4 mm iron, full contact
40 x 40 x 4 mm low carbon steel, nickel plated
72 N per unit (2 kPa + growth + 7.7 N m)
components.test: Hold the tail on the hoop with 1 kPa inside; pull with a spring scale.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: layout fixed at r 185 (90, 210, 330 deg), all above water; worst load 72 N per unit.

components.name: Mill-Max 0906 spring pins
components.role: charge the mother node and carry serial data
components.how: Four pins on the top of the tail rim meet gold pads on the hoop, above the waterline.
components.test: Dock 50 times; check contact on all pins.

components.name: Dock lip seal, SORTA-Clear 18
components.role: seals the collar tip to the bore shoulder, above water
components.how: A cast lip on the collar tip leans 30 deg outward and bends 2 to 3 mm on the shoulder. Womb pressure presses the lip down.
specs: 52 N at 1 kPa, 104 N at 2 kPa
components.test: Dock in water, pressure to 1 kPa, watch for bubbles 1 h.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: lip seal on the collar tip at D 257 instead of a D ring at D 276.

components.name: Lead in: recess in the mother, collar on the tail
components.role: guides the tail onto the bore; carries the lip seal
components.how: A 28 mm collar on the tail mouth enters the 30 mm recess in the mother. Flat faces meet first; the cone only centers. No long nose.
specs: 28 tall, D 308 to D 265, bore D 250

sources.label: Hennessey 1982, Compliant part mating and minimum energy chamfer design (MIT MS thesis)

components.test: Approach at 20 mm offset; cone must center the tail.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: female recess in the mother and a short collar on the tail instead of a cone on the tail mouth.

components.name: Baby skin, printed FX-Pro
components.role: folded body that inflates and is born
components.how: Printed folded in the gel around the capsule. The capsule's valve boss stays open to the outside.
specs: 1 bead about 1.6 mm, caps 2 beads about 3 mm
D 210 at x -0.040 m, from two boom stations

sources.label: Hajash et al. 2017, Large Scale Rapid Liquid Printing, doi 10.1089/3dp.2017.0037 (MIT DSpace)

components.test: Print a 100 mm closed pleat test, inflate to 1 kPa in water.
components.changed_in_v2: v2: DS10 NV, print disc at x -0.040, two boom stations, volume cap for one cartridge.

components.name: Ball needle valve core
components.role: only opening of the capsule; holds the baby's air
components.how: A rubber valve core like a basketball valve, set in the capsule boss. The 14G needle enters to inflate.
specs: D 1.5 to 2.5 mm, length 24 to 38 mm (patent)

sources.label: US8579744B2, inflation valve core for sports balls
Artist's Weekly Updates deck (S8 design, gel tests)

components.test: Insert the needle 50 times; valve must hold 2 kPa after.

components.role: brain of the baby: radio, IMU, motor driver
components.how: ESP32-C6 board with a BNO085 9 axis IMU and two H bridges. Runs the pump and reports pressure by BLE.
specs: 2 H bridges, 1.5 A one, 750 mA each two

components.role: powers the capsule
components.how: Same cell type the artist bought. Charge fully before sealing; the CodeCell charger is slow.
components.test: Run pump and radio from full; log hours to cutoff.

components.name: AITIAO 3 to 5 V micro submersible pump (owned)
components.role: water jet for the baby to swim
components.how: Sits in the wet bay under the capsule. Inlet and outlet tubes pass through the skin.

components.name: Electronics capsule shell
components.role: dry home for board, cell and sensor
components.how: Two clear halves with a face O ring and 4 screws. The valve boss and a side port lead air into the baby.
specs: silicone cord O ring, then Ecoflex 00-35 FAST over the seam
carried on the needle, set into the gel
components.test: Sink the closed capsule 300 mm for 24 h; weigh for water.

mother_segments.joints: Inward 12 mm flanges. Removable seams: 2.5 mm silicone cord in a groove, M3 A4 screws at 30 mm. Permanent seams (rear and front halves): 3M DP100 Plus Clear. Belly skin clamped by a printed ring.
mother_segments.notes: 7 lower hull pieces (keel cap below z = -0.274 m plus 6 gores to z = -0.060 m), 2 rear wall halves, 2 front plate halves. Also Clear V5: 1 bore hoop and 4 gel tray quarters. Fit found by a bounding box search; confirm every piece in the slicer. Clear V5 gains 0.9% in 24 h in water.
mother_segments.changed_in_v2: Plus one chute print. The bore hoop becomes the bore ring; the recess and pads sit in the rear wall halves; the tray is round D 410.
